chapter: Early years and the Sonny South
title: Father's piano, house-party bands and first job at the Halfway House
summary: His father bought a piano and he taught himself. He formed small house-party groups with Wilford Boccage and others, and his first professional job across the river was at the Halfway House.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
